extracted.intended_audience: EPO examiners, patent attorneys/agents and patent applicants using the European patent system
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the European Patent Office 'Guidelines for Examination' (November 2015) covering formalities, search, substantive examination, opposition/limitation, procedural matters, the European patent application, patentability and amendments/corrections. The document sets out the standards and procedures applied in examining and processing European patent applications and related proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements relating to filing a European patent application and the examination carried out at the time of filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of formal requirements that an application must meet (e.g. content, form) before further processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications concerning formal deficiencies; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: How formal deficiencies are communicated, the opportunity and rules for amendment of the application, and correction of errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to Examining Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and timing for publication of the application, filing of a request for substantive examination, and transfer of the dossier to the Examining Division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements and options for filing, prosecution and proceedings before the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: General/common procedural provisions applicable across formalities examination and related steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive requirements for drawings submitted in a European patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee structure, payment requirements and consequences of non-payment relevant to filing and prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the European Patent Register; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing public and party access to file contents, consultation of the Register and issuance of certified copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards describing what constitutes an appropriate prior art search and its characteristics at the EPO search stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural guidance and strategies for conducting searches, including approach and documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification (routing) and official classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing and classification practices used to allocate and classify applications for searching and examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and treatment of the relevant state of the art for purposes of the search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity of invention for the purposes of carrying out a search and related consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject-matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of subject-matter that should be excluded from the search (e.g. non‑technical matter) and why.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation standards for search results and the sources to be consulted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Content and preparation standards for the search report issued by the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Purpose and contents of the search opinion accompanying the search report (e.g. preliminary assessment of patentability).

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the Division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: List and conditions of formal requirements that must be satisfied before substantive examination commences.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: The initial substantive examination steps and standards applied in the early stage of prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: How applicant replies are examined and the procedures for subsequent examination stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedural steps for concluding substantive examination, including granting or refusal stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on statutory and procedural time limits, as well as options and criteria for accelerated processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional procedural matters and practices occurring during substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the Examining Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisational and procedural aspects of how the Examining Division conducts its work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for particular or exceptional types of applications (e.g. special sectors or filings).

rubrics_metrics.name: General remarks (opposition and limitation/revocation procedures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Overarching principles and approach to opposition, limitation and revocation proceedings before the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Opposition Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Role, composition and procedures of the Opposition Division in opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition (procedural rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural steps, formalities and admissibility rules for filing and pursuing an opposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure up to substantive examination (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures leading up to substantive examination of an opposition (preliminary processing, communications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and criteria applied when examining the substantive merits of an opposition (novelty, inventive step, added matter, sufficiency, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the Opposition Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Form and content of decisions issued by the Opposition Division, including grounds and possible outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and practice regarding apportionment and awarding of costs in opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules governing central limitation and revocation of European patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for how communications and official notifications are effected in EPO proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and conduct of oral proceedings before the EPO, including hearing procedures and participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for submitting, admitting and preserving evidence in EPO proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derogations from the language of the proceedings in oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and rules allowing deviations from the official language of proceedings during oral hearings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on EPO-initiated examination, late-submitted material, and how third-party observations are handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption and stay of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures for interrupting or staying patent proceedings before the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and re-establishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed rules on time limits, consequences of missing them, possibilities for acceleration and restoration of rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment and special rules applicable to international (PCT) applications entering the European phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: General principles governing the form, content and notification of decisions issued by the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive standards for lodging and conducting appeals against EPO decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request from a national court for a technical opinion concerning a European patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for and role of EPO in providing technical opinions to national courts on European patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of changes of name, transfers, licences and other rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements to register changes in ownership, transfers, licences and related rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a European patent application (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Required and recommended content for description, abstract, drawings and other parts of the application excluding the claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for considering the abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Checklist standards to assess and prepare the abstract of a European patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units recognised in international practice and complying with Rule 49(10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted units of measurement and formatting that comply with Rule 49(10) when preparing an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for determining whether the invention is disclosed sufficiently clearly and completely for a skilled person to carry it out (Art.83 EPC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and clarity requirements for claims, and assessment under Article 84 EPC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples concerning essential features
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples to determine which features are essential to the claimed invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application/examination)
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles for assessing unity of invention for examination and how lack of unity is handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on claiming priority from earlier applications and the conditions for its valid assertion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Overarching criteria for what subject-matter is patentable under the EPC framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions (definition and borderline issues)
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of 'invention' and discussion of borderline subject-matter issues (e.g. exclusions, examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and examples showing how the industrial applicability criterion is applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and scope of the state of the art for novelty and inventive step assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-prejudicial disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of disclosures that do not prejudice novelty or inventive step (e.g. grace periods, exhibitions) and their treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for assessing novelty of claimed subject-matter against the prior art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive step
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and approaches for assessing inventive step (non-obviousness) including related indicators and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annex: Examples relating to the requirement of inventive step – indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples and indicators used to inform inventive step assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: The right to amend
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and scope of the applicant's and proprietor's right to amend the application or patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General admissibility rules governing amendments during prosecution and opposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – other procedural matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Further procedural considerations affecting admissibility of amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – Art. 123(2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules prohibiting added subject-matter beyond the content of the application as filed (Art.123(2) EPC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – Art. 123(3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules prohibiting extension of the protection conferred by the patent as granted (Art.123(3) EPC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments – examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Worked examples illustrating allowable and non-allowable amendments under the relevant EPC provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for correcting errors in applications and granted patents.
